validation: validateInputs(raw) -> {valid:boolean, errors:[{field,message}], input:normalizedObject|null}. runPlan(raw) invalid -> {ok:false,errors}; expected invalid input does not throw.
dates: startMonth, educationDate, stressStartMonth: required YYYY-MM strings. educationDate is comparison month even when educationTarget=0.
numbers: All NUMERIC_FIELDS required, explicit zero accepted, blank/null/bool/array/nonfinite rejected; 0..1e13 KRW; month counts integer0..600, rates percent0..100.
scenario: {summary:object,path:object[]}. Path includes month0 initial snapshot and months1..projectionMonths. Chart comparison paths should filter month<=comparisonMonths.

summaryKeyMeanings.cash: Total deposits, includes educationBalance; never add the two as assets.
summaryKeyMeanings.loanBalance: Remaining loan principal; includes overdue principal.
summaryKeyMeanings.unpaidInterest: Accrued loan interest not paid; separate liability.
summaryKeyMeanings.unpaidLiving: Accrued consumption expense not paid; separate liability.
summaryKeyMeanings.loanArrears: Overdue scheduled payments; subset of principal+unpaidInterest, not an additional liability.
summaryKeyMeanings.firstLiquidityShortfallMonth: First month with mandatory payments unpaid, null if none. Distinct from savings shortfall or cash-floor breach.
summaryKeyMeanings.minFreeCash: Minimum non-earmarked deposits through comparison month including initial state.
summaryKeyMeanings.cashFloorShortfall: Shortfall versus preferred floor; does not imply arrears.
summaryKeyMeanings.payoffMonth: Full projection payoff month integer; 0 for no original debt; null if not repaid in projection. Assumes continued fixed input income/expenses.
summaryKeyMeanings.cumulativeInterest: Interest accrued through comparison date, including unpaid interest.
summaryKeyMeanings.lifetimeInterestWithinProjection: Interest through longer fixed-input projection; not guaranteed realized cost.
summaryKeyMeanings.cumulativeMissedEducation: Base planned education payments not made through comparison date; no automatic catch-up.
summaryKeyMeanings.cumulativeEducationWithdrawals: Education earmark consumed to meet mandatory outflows.

identity: Net worth change = earned income - accrued living expense - accrued interest - prepayment fee. Principal repayments, investment/pension deposits, education earmarks are transfers.
comparisonWarning: No outcome ranking is inherent: debt lowers interest, education raises assigned education balance, cash preserves free cash. Same positive-return assets are not modeled; target success probability not estimated.
